result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The carousel clipping and the pizza card cut off at the bottom are expected and not reported. The only findings are minor styling and accessibility issues around contrast and the promo banner.

issues.description: The white promo text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is small and sits on a mid-green gradient with decorative circles behind it. Contrast is modest, especially over the lighter circle area.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner green or increase the text size and weight so the small text meets WCAG 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The gray secondary text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', inactive tab labels, search placeholder) is light gray on white or light gray, giving low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker gray for secondary text and inactive nav labels to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the illustration and sit close to the card's left edge. On the first card the badge partly covers the bowl image.
issues.suggestion: Give the badges consistent padding and position them so they don't cover the key part of the image.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the dark card image has a low-contrast translucent background. On the pizza card it blends into the wood background.
issues.suggestion: Use a solid or higher-opacity light circular background for the favorite icon.
